basics.name: Adam Klie
basics.label: Co-Founder & Head of Technology, Gaius Therapeutics
basics.summary: Co-Founder and Head of Technology at Gaius Therapeutics, an early-stage biotechnology company. Computational biologist and machine learning researcher (PhD, UC San Diego) working to decode the non-coding genome and translate it into new medicines. Former professional basketball player. The best way to reach me is by email — adam@gaius.bio or adamklie13@gmail.com.

work.name: Gaius Therapeutics
highlights: Co-founded the company and lead its technology and computational platform.

work.name: UC San Diego
work.summary: Developed machine learning methods to link non-coding genetic variation to gene-regulatory function and built scalable tools for large-scale genomics.

work.name: UC San Diego — Carter Lab
work.summary: PhD research on deep learning for regulatory genomics, advised by Hannah Carter.
highlights: Created EUGENe, an open-source Python toolkit for deep learning in regulatory genomics (Nature Computational Science, 2023).
Built sequence-to-function models to predict regulatory element activity and interpret non-coding variation.

work.summary: Visiting researcher working on sequence-based deep learning models of chromatin and gene regulation.
